$comment: Shadow round judge (operator OK 2026-10-21). rounds.judge.mode off|shadow|on resolves standard (off) -> platform preference `rounds` -> this file -> env WE_ROUNDS_JUDGE_MODE, source logged. shadow = at a round cap the review daemon's status tagger logs what the judge WOULD do to ~/workspace/.operations/round-judge-shadow/; it never acts. `on` is not implemented and behaves as shadow. See scripts/conveyor/round-judge-shadow.mjs. rounds.judge.maxGrants (standard 20) is only a hard backstop on total recommended grants per PR; progress decides. rounds.nonConverging.enabled (standard false) turns on the R469 stop: at least two review/red-team rounds with open findings not shrinking (including repeats; referral rounds excluded) gives verdict non-converging (redesign, D-R451) instead of a further round. rounds.nonConverging.enforce=extend-rounds enforces this stop at the operator grant point regardless of judge shadow mode.
